bio: The magnificent Rosendael Castle houses this fashionable upscale bistro that affords views over the delightful surrounding grounds. This is a seriously cool bistro bar! The wide-ranging menu proposes a range of appealing entrées served in modest portions that diners will find hard to resist. Vegetarian options, a classic cod dish, meat specialities, the house version of an eclair for dessert… You'll be spoilt for choice!...
